results.name: Flood in Germany
results.reason: On the 22 September a flood event is forecast to hit Brandenburg's rivers between the confluence of Oder and Neisse at the state border between Germany and Poland. The raising surface in the affected areas is due to the heavy rainfalls occurred in Middle and Eastern Europe.Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
